description.en:
Moves a named caption (created with one of the CMND_2DO_CREATE_*_TELOP functions) to a screen position.
The cutscene scripts call it every frame while animating a caption, usually centring it with the size returned when it was created.
Name of the caption to move.

null if the engine is not ready, fewer than 3 arguments were given, or no caption has that name.
On success the native reports a result without pushing one, so Squirrel hands back the last argument (the y value).

examples.case: Centring an animated caption each frame (real usage, from ie4_ev_sub_skl.nut; caption names shortened from the script's Shift-JIS names)
